paragraphs: Although Apple did not include the iPhone Duo’s wallpapers in iOS 27, the company did include them in the iPhone simulator in Xcode 27.1 beta, released earlier today, which means now you can download them. Get them below.
Earlier this month, Apple announced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, with dedicated light and dark mode wallpapers depicting dunes against a mountain range.

On that same day, Apple released the RC version of iOS 27.0, which included the company’s official wallpapers for the new iPhone 18 Pro. Alas, the system did not include the wallpapers for the iPhone Duo.

Today, however, Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta, which includes the new artwork in its iPhone Simulator. This means you can now download all four wallpapers Apple developed for the iPhone Duo, two for light mode and two for dark mode.
Be sure to click the images and save the full-resolution versions before setting them as your wallpaper. Here are Apple’s official guides to set iPhone, iPad, and Mac wallpapers.
What do you think of the iPhone Duo wallpapers? Let us know in the comments.
Marcus Mendes is a Brazilian tech podcaster and journalist who has been closely following Apple since the mid-2000s.
He began covering Apple news in Brazilian media in 2012 and later broadened his focus to the wider tech industry, hosting a daily podcast for seven years.
